sources.title: GeneralVLA-2: Geometry-Aware Reconstruction and Governed Memory for ...
sources.snippet: GeneralVLA-2 first adds an object-side multi-view reconstruction branch to complement the original SAM-based affordance segmentation and iterative localization interface. With calibrated multi-view RGB-D observations around the same object, monocular hallucination becomes less necessary than it is in a single-image setup.
